hide_all_ui: Hide all UI hides the loading panel and collapsed tab locally. F8 restores the panel. Holds, free camera and F9/F10 remain active; visibility resets on page reload.
arm_all: Opt-in checkbox; Rush/Boss/Timed arm commands over BroadcastChannel to same-origin tabs in the same browser storage partition. Active holds are preserved; separate profiles and native clients are separate groups.
free_camera: GUI toggle while a map is loaded and player readiness is held; WASD/arrows, Shift faster; draw fields restored each frame; unavailable before map creation
sc_test_behavior: Guided loading controls; rush -> explicit room preview -> manual reconnect; boss hold; timed 360-second early wait into preview. Preview continues asset readiness once and holds world readiness, including recovery. Explicit fallback if early phase absent. Holds persist across natural losses. F8 panel; F9 selected mode; F10 next/finish.
sc_test_limits: No automatic platform detector or guarantee of hold lifetime, mission retention, checkpoint or chest window.
